title: Project Website Overclaim Guardrails v1 — Rig Relay
description: Explicit allowlist and denylist of claims that may appear on the Rig Relay product front door. Every allowed claim references a canonical source artifact. A website implementation or validation scan must reject any claim not on this list.
principle: The product front door must build trust through evidence, not overstatement. If a claim cannot cite a canonical artifact that says it is complete, the claim must not appear. Status chips must accurately reflect documented state.

allowed_claims.claim: Cross-surface authority spine governs all protocol surfaces (cockpit, CLI, MCP, ACP, WebSocket)
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: One authority spine governs every surface. Cockpit, CLI, MCP, ACP, WebSocket — no surface is exempt.

allowed_claims.claim: Governance decisions produce ReceiptEnvelope evidence with governance_decision_id and content-light classification
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: Every governance decision is recorded as schema-governed evidence with content-light classification.

allowed_claims.claim: MCP read-only surface is hardened: descriptor integrity, roots boundary, content-light scanning, receipt-backed, non-anonymous, tier-authorized
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: Hardened MCP read-only surface. 16 tools, 6 resources, 3 prompts. 94/94 gate tests pass.

allowed_claims.claim: MCP mutation tools (tier 4-5) are permanently blocked
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: MCP mutation tools are blocked. No agent can mutate through MCP.

allowed_claims.claim: CLI scripts require --execute with approval receipt for mutation operations
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: CLI mutation gates enforce dry-run default and --execute with approval.

allowed_claims.claim: Content-light telemetry with four-category model: product telemetry, remote contribution, operational observability, enterprise evidence
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: Content-light telemetry. Four-category model. No raw code, secrets, or private paths.

allowed_claims.claim: Receipt-backed evidence with Merkle-linked receipt store
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: Merkle-linked receipt store. Every tool call produces a verifiable receipt.

allowed_claims.claim: DuckDB read-side analytics over governance decisions
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: DuckDB read-side analytics. Query your governance data.

allowed_claims.claim: 400+ JSON schemas govern all evidence artifacts
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: 400+ schemas govern every artifact. Schema validation in CI.
Local-first. Desktop cockpit. No cloud required.

allowed_claims.claim: Dirty-file preservation prevents parallel agent lane conflicts
allowed_claims.front_door_phrasing: Dirty-file preservation. Multiple agents can work without overwriting each other.

allowed_claims_with_partial_status.claim: GitHub operating picture with code scanning integration and live PR rehearsal
allowed_claims_with_partial_status.front_door_phrasing: GitHub operating picture with code scanning integration. Trust Spine roadmap for cryptographic enforcement.

allowed_claims_with_partial_status.claim: Postgres enterprise substrate planned for operational projection
allowed_claims_with_partial_status.front_door_phrasing: Postgres enterprise substrate planned. DuckDB available today.

allowed_claims_with_partial_status.claim: Roadmap Steward agent for lane coordination and slice ranking
allowed_claims_with_partial_status.front_door_phrasing: Roadmap Steward spec exists. Implementation planned.

forbidden_claims.reason: No SOC 2 audit conducted. No operating history.
No DPA. No formal privacy program. Privacy notice is alpha.
Not a healthcare tool. No BAA.
No US government sponsor. No authorization.
Local-first only. Hosted path planned, not implemented.
SSH must stay absent until SSH doctrine is fully implemented.
A2A spec exists but not implemented.
No SLSA provenance generation. Build attestation not implemented.

validation_rules.scan_before_publish: Every generated HTML page must be scanned for forbidden claim strings before deployment.
validation_rules.claim_citation_required: Every affirmative claim on the product front door must have a visible or accessible source artifact link.
validation_rules.status_chip_accuracy: Status chips must match the artifact's documented status (implemented, partial, planned, deferred, blocked). 'implemented' must not appear where artifact says 'partial' or 'planned'.
validation_rules.forbidden_string_scan: A CI check must scan generated static HTML for forbidden claim strings (e.g., 'SOC 2', 'enterprise ready', 'production ready'). Any match must block publish.
